$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A device running OpenWrt or a vendor fork of it: the root login opens the web interface and SSH, by password or by key. The old profile named it together with wifi-access-point; a record here may be bound to both, and the shared properties must then agree.
title: OpenWrt device
description: A device running OpenWrt: its identifiers, its admin login and its SSH key.

URL.description: The admin web interface. Often a local http:// address, which is a valid address.

UserName.description: The user name of the admin login, usually root.

Password.description: The password of the admin login. A fresh device may have none yet.

ssh_key.description: The private SSH key the device accepts.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid. Empty means it does not expire.

allOf.description: The admin login is recorded: where it is, and who opens it.
